extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13+ (the Bases view API and declarative settings).
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that adds a Kanban board view to Obsidian Bases, so you can plan, track, and schedule any set of notes visually.
motivation: I built this because I wanted my planning to live in my notes, not in yet another app.
problem: Users need a way to visualize and manage complex projects and tasks directly within their existing Obsidian notes and Bases, rather than relying on external project management tools.

relations.evidence: Define your note types yourself, or let the Obsidian Starter Kit plugin configure them for you when it's installed.
applies the template with Templater when you have it, before writing the card's properties
Vault scripts (Templater, QuickAdd, the developer console) can read a note's tracked time

summary: A plugin that adds configurable Kanban boards, calendars, and timelines to Obsidian Bases, allowing users to plan, track, and schedule notes visually using note properties.
